note: Settings › General › Credits & licenses reads this file. Every pin in the build's Package.resolved must have an entry with a matching "pin" (scripts/check_licenses.py fails the build otherwise). License texts sit next to this file in Contents/Resources/Licenses.

entries.name: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2
entries.what: The English speech-to-text model behind dictation and meeting transcripts. Converted to Core ML by FluidInference, unmodified weights.

entries.name: FluidAudio
entries.what: Runs the speech models on Core ML: speech-to-text, voice detection and who-spoke-when.

entries.name: NemoTextProcessing (text-processing-rs)
entries.what: Prebuilt text normalization library that FluidAudio links in.

entries.name: WhisperKit (argmax-oss-swift)
entries.what: Optional Whisper speech engines for dictation.

entries.name: Swift Argument Parser
entries.what: Resolved as a dependency of WhisperKit (used by its command-line tool).
entries.copyright: Copyright Apple Inc. and the Swift project authors

entries.name: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3
entries.what: Optional 25-language speech model. Converted to Core ML by FluidInference.

entries.name: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT-CTC 110M
entries.what: Vocabulary helper that spots your custom words. Converted to Core ML by FluidInference.

entries.name: Parakeet Ultra
entries.what: Optional accurate speech model by Moondream. Converted to Core ML by FluidInference.

entries.name: Silero VAD
entries.what: Voice activity detection: finds where you're talking. Converted to Core ML by FluidInference.

entries.name: pyannote speaker-diarization-community-1 + WeSpeaker
entries.what: Who-spoke-when segmentation and voice fingerprints for meetings. Converted to Core ML by FluidInference.

entries.name: OpenAI Whisper (large-v3 turbo, distil-large-v3)
entries.what: Optional Whisper speech models, in Argmax's Core ML conversions (MIT).

entries.name: Handy
entries.what: Scribe's dictation design follows Handy (hold-to-talk and toggle hotkeys, silence trimming, paste and restore the clipboard). Scribe's code is a new Swift implementation.

entries.name: Apple Foundation Models
entries.what: Optional on-device clean-up and meeting notes on macOS 26 with Apple Intelligence.

entries.name: Self-test audio (LibriSpeech, AMI Meeting Corpus)
entries.what: Test clips used only by Scribe's built-in self-test.
entries.copyright: LibriSpeech: Panayotov et al.; AMI: University of Edinburgh and partners
